tldr: This is a loose cluster of four independent arXiv papers, not one event: each attacks the cost of long-context attention by letting a query attend only to a selected subset of keys. It opened with work on DeepSeek Sparse Attention's learned indexer, then two training-free methods that choose keys by semantic blocks or per-head structure.
whats_new: DTS (Nov 19) scores attention tiles by deltas to decide which blocks to skip, targeting the prefill bottleneck of long documents and codebases.
why_it_matters: Sparse attention is where long-context prefill cost and KV memory traffic get cut, so these selection methods decide how cheap 100K-token RAG and codebase prompts become in serving stacks.

beats.headline: Overlapping selection and attention in DeepSeek Sparse Attention
beats.summary: Starts from production-style sparse attention, where a learned indexer picks keys per query.

beats.headline: Two methods pick keys without retraining the model
beats.summary: One clusters keys into coarse semantic blocks; the other adapts sparsity per attention head.

beats.headline: DTS: delta-based tile scoring for block-sparse prefill

open_questions: Do any of these methods ship in vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM kernels?
Which method holds accuracy on long-context benchmarks like RULER at matched sparsity?
Do the training-free methods compose with KV-cache quantization and prefix caching?
take_for_builders: Treat these as research only: wait for a serving-engine kernel and an independent long-context accuracy eval before swapping attention in production.

day_captions.2ef0f5e9028f8dae: Anchors the thread in DeepSeek Sparse Attention, overlapping the indexer's selection with attention compute.
day_captions.2d77f36eefa1549d: Adds a training-free option: a prompt-specific key index built from coarse semantic blocks for prefill and decode.
day_captions.da4e6d10d3401d6d: Argues sparsity should vary by head, chosen from each head's query-key interaction structure.
day_captions.f350b66d46c34624: Shifts focus to prefill, scoring tiles by deltas to decide which blocks block-sparse attention skips.
